name: Difficulty Plus
description: Adds three new difficulty faces: Casual, Tough and Extreme.

enable-casual.name: Casual (3 stars)
enable-casual.description: Show the <cj>Casual</c> face on 3 star levels instead of Normal.

enable-normal.name: Normal (4 stars)
enable-normal.description: Move <cg>Normal</c> onto 4 star levels, where Hard would normally sit. Uses the game's own Normal face.

enable-tough.name: Tough (7 stars)
enable-tough.description: Show the <cr>Tough</c> face on 7 star levels instead of Harder.

enable-extreme.name: Extreme (9 stars)
enable-extreme.description: Show the <cp>Extreme</c> face on 9 star levels instead of Insane.
